title: Separate pure outputs from surviving correct starting roots
statement: For identical attempts with exclusive correct irreversible p, wrong irreversible w, death d and harmless f=1-p-w-d, false advancement h on harmless failures, and eventual correct/wrong reader acceptance A_C,A_W, the terminal good and bad advancement probabilities are G=p*A_C/(p+w+d+f*h), B=(w*A_W+f*h)/(p+w+d+f*h). With the declared identical independent stage law, correct-root yield is G^L, controller-declared-complete output fraction (G+B)^L and conditional correct purity [G/(G+B)]^L. Even ideal postbond rejection with d=h=0 gives root yield at most[p/(p+w)]^L.

requires: Valid exclusive p,w,d,f,h and a positive terminal denominator; every harmless retry restores the same competent parent.
Actual product-acceptance probabilities and declared long-chain stage law; no repair or reversal of an irreversible wrong bond is supplied.

With the declared identical independent stage law, correct-root yield is G^L, controller-declared-complete output fraction (G+B)^L and conditional correct purity [G/(G+B)]^L. assumptions: A constant iid false-read law is required for eventual false acceptance1; arbitrary correlated/adaptive tests need their actual joint observation law.
Pure selected products do not imply high yield per starting root or finite completion time.
costs: Charge all attempts, irreversible losses, culls, chemistry/readout time and roots that never finish.
contract.units: Dimensionless probabilities/counts; purity conditional on output and yield per original root have different denominators.
contract.obstruction: Prevent wrong irreversible bonds before commitment or acquire real excision/repair; filtering alone does not restore lost roots.

body: First-step conditioning resumes the parent only on f*(1-h), so divide terminal probabilities by1-f*(1-h). A formed irreversible product that never passes is culled/stalled, not restored to the original parent. Its reader accepts eventually with r/(r+c) if pass and irreversible cull probabilities per repeated read are r,c and r+c>0. When c=0 and r>0, unlimited iid reads eventually pass with probability1. Thus reducing false pass speed without culling/repair does not save indefinite readout. The powers require independent identical stages (or the corresponding conditional factorization) and nonzero output probability for conditional purity. Here output means controller-declared advancement; false advancement need not create a chemically full-length molecule. Preserve persistent/stalled/dead roots in the denominator when assessing manufacturing yield.

evidence.range_scope: Actual absorbing-stage probabilities, purity-versus-root-yield distinction and repeated-reader failure.
